# Version 4.147.0
> **Skia m147 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.147.0-preview)

> **Superseded by [4.148.0](4.148.0.md)** · Never released as stable — these changes rolled up into 4.148.0.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.147.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/8.3.1.6/index.md)

## Highlights

The v4 preview line advances to Skia m147 with variable fonts, SKPathBuilder, and broader platform support. It adds animated WebP encoding, color font palettes, explicit surface sampling, and new stream and GPU APIs. Preview consumers should note the new SKPathBuilder migration, the .NET 8 floor for WebAssembly native assets, and the assembly-version change.

## Breaking Changes

- **GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo moves to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. Move code to the correctly cased type; the legacy type no longer provides IEquatable, Equals, or equality operators. ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))
- **WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 8** — Native assets for the Emscripten versions used by .NET 6 and .NET 7 are removed. Upgrade Blazor WebAssembly and Uno Platform WebAssembly projects to .NET 8 or later. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))
- **Assembly version advances to 4.147.0.0** — SkiaSharp.dll moves from assembly version 3.119.0.0 to 4.147.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and any checks pinned to the 3.x assembly version. ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))

## Engine

- **Skia advances from m119 to m147** — The bundled engine incorporates newer codec orientation handling, HDR and wide-gamut improvements, color-aware filters, and accumulated raster and filter corrections. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **SKPathBuilder becomes the path construction API** — SKPathBuilder wraps the immutable-path model introduced upstream, while existing SKPath mutation methods remain available with obsolete warnings for migration. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702))
- **Default typeface resolution moves to the managed layer** — SKTypeface.Default now resolves through SKFontManager with an empty-typeface fallback, preventing Android API 36 startup crashes and adding SKTypeface.Empty and IsEmpty. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))

## API Surface

- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — SKTypeface and HarfBuzzSharp gain APIs for variation axes, named instances, design coordinates, palette selection, and per-color overrides. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Explicit sampling for surface draws** — New SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions so callers can control filtering when compositing surfaces. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding and stream-backed SKData** — SKWebpEncoder can encode frame sequences, while SKStream.GetData returns the backing SKData when a stream can expose it without copying. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **New document, GPU, mask filter, and color APIs** — Adds SKDocument.CreateXps options, per-resource GRContext.Flush overloads, SKMaskFilter.CreateShader, SKColorSpace.CreateCicp, and new HDR color types. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560))

## Bug Fixes

- **SKPath finalization no longer depends on builder collection order** — Disposal avoids flushing a builder after finalization has begun, preventing a native crash when SKPathBuilder is collected first. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Variable-font spans and glyph checks are hardened** — Undersized variation spans now follow Skia's all-or-nothing semantics correctly, and byte-span ContainsGlyphs no longer recurses until a stack overflow. ([#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Android SKGLView survives navigation and tab switches** — Reattached GL views retain their dimensions instead of creating a zero-sized surface that remains blank. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076))
- **NanoServer starts without a system font manager** — Windows NanoServer uses an empty font manager when DirectWrite and GDI are unavailable, avoiding an access violation during first use. ([#3835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3835))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen assets** — Native packages add linux-bionic x64 and arm64 assets plus tizen-x64 and tizen-arm64 support. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple library target frameworks use the base 26.0 workload** — Apple NuGet assets target 26.0 rather than 26.2, allowing consumers to build with any compatible Xcode 26 workload. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798))
- **WebAssembly native support starts at .NET 8** — The packages retain Emscripten assets for .NET 8 and later and report a clear build error on unsupported .NET 6 and .NET 7 projects. ([#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6

HarfBuzzSharp 8.3.1.6 adds variable-font and color-palette APIs, introduces HBColor with correct channel semantics, and extends native assets to Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen.
